description: Evaluation criteria for Dev10x:qa-self — artifact verification before publishing, the local evidence-review gate, run-scoped capture paths, and annotated recordings

eval_dimensions.name: Phase 4.1 Artifact Verification
eval_dimensions.description: Every captured screenshot and video is run through verify-evidence.py before conversion, review or upload; a failing verdict sends the run back to re-capture instead of publishing. A green capture run is never treated as proof the artifacts show anything.

eval_dimensions.name: Phase 4.4 Local Evidence Review Gate
eval_dimensions.description: The supervisor approves the evidence locally via a blocking AskUserQuestion (approve / re-capture / abort) before any upload to Linear. Plain-text confirmation, or uploading first and asking after, is a violation — evidence trails are append-only.

eval_dimensions.name: Run-Scoped Capture Paths
eval_dimensions.description: Artifacts are written to a run-scoped directory (and --basetemp for pytest-driven runs) so a parallel session's basetemp rotation cannot destroy them mid-session.

eval_dimensions.name: Phase 3 Test-Failure Recovery Gate
eval_dimensions.description: When a test case fails during execution, the recovery choice (fix and retry / skip the case / abort) is put to the supervisor through a blocking AskUserQuestion — never decided silently, and never as a plain-text question.

eval_dimensions.name: Annotated Recording via the Shared Module
eval_dimensions.description: Walkthrough recordings import skills/playwright/lib/annotate.py rather than pasting an overlay inline; the overlay is installed with add_init_script so it survives navigation, and captions are set only after navigation completes.

evals.name: A blank screenshot fails verification and is not uploaded
evals.description: A capture step no-opped behind a silent conditional, leaving a uniform screenshot
evals.input: QA run completed; one captured PNG is a single flat colour below the size floor

assertions.signal: runs_verifier — verify-evidence.py is invoked on every captured artifact before conversion or upload
halts_on_failure — the failing artifact is reported and the run returns to capture; no upload is attempted
names_silent_guard — the diagnosis identifies the silent conditional capture guard as the cause, not a cosmetic issue
asserts_in_viewport — the re-captured script proves the subject is in the viewport at shoot time (target_center on a non-null bounding box), not just present in the DOM

evals.name: Evidence review blocks on AskUserQuestion before upload
evals.description: All artifacts pass verification and are ready to publish
evals.input: QA run completed; screenshots and video converted and verified clean

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion is called at the pre-upload review point
offers_documented_options — options are approve / re-capture / abort, with approve marked Recommended
no_upload_before_approval — upload-screenshots.py runs only after the approve option is selected
surfaces_artifact_facts — the gate reports each artifact's path, size and verifier verdict so the choice is informed

evals.name: A failing test case blocks on the recovery gate
evals.description: One test case fails mid-execution while others still pass
evals.input: Phase 3 run: TC2 fails on a missing selector; TC1 and TC3 pass

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion is called when a test case fails, per tool-calls/ask-test-failure-recovery.md
offers_documented_options — options are fix and retry (Recommended) / skip the failing case / abort
no_silent_skip — the failing case is never dropped from the results table without the supervisor choosing to skip it

evals.name: Capture artifacts land in a run-scoped directory
evals.description: Generated test script writes screenshots and video
evals.input: Phase 2 generates the Playwright script for a QA ticket

assertions.signal: run_scoped_dir — SCREENSHOT_DIR and VIDEO_DIR are nested under a per-run directory, never a bare /tmp or pytest default basetemp
pytest_basetemp — a pytest-driven capture passes --basetemp pointing at the same run-scoped directory

evals.name: Annotation survives navigation across a multi-page flow
evals.description: A walkthrough recording spans several pages
evals.input: QA flow navigates from the work order list to a detail page and back

assertions.signal: imports_shared_module — the script imports annotate.Annotator via DEV10X_PLAYWRIGHT_LIB instead of pasting overlay JS inline
install_before_navigation — Annotator.install() is called once; the overlay is not re-injected after each goto
captions_after_navigation — say() calls follow the navigation they describe, never precede a goto
click_wrapper_ordering — interactions go through Annotator.click(announce=...) so pointing precedes narration precedes the action
